run_pybullet_stretch_simulation: run a pybullet GUI simulation that loads a Stretch robot URDF and iterates through joint configurations
test_robot_joint_configurations: test robot joint configurations by looping through angle ranges and resetting joint states in pybullet
load_urdf_in_pybullet: load a URDF robot model into a pybullet simulation with a specified start position and orientation
reset_robot_base_and_joints: reset the robot base position and orientation then set individual joint states using pybullet resetJointState
inspect_robot_joint_info: inspect and print joint information for a loaded pybullet robot using getJointInfo
